title: Purple Oni Character Poses
description: Three distinct full-body poses of a stylized demonic character with white and purple hair, horns, and skull motifs. The figure wears a purple and white outfit with swirling patterns, a skull belt, and clawed gauntlets, shown crouching, mid-air jumping, and in a dynamic standing stance against a plain gray background.
prompt: A Japanese-inspired demonic trickster character with pale skin, purple and white spiky hair, small horns, and a mischievous grin. He wears a purple and off-white outfit with spiral patterns, a black belt with a skull buckle, purple arm wraps, and clawed gauntlets. Three full-body action poses: crouching low with tail visible, leaping in mid-air, and a dynamic combat stance, all on a neutral gray studio background, clean digital illustration style.
